descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-08 Handoff Summary · S07 「现成 api spec：谁能发给谁、谁能读——同事收到；发给自己、邮箱地址、空文字被拒；外人和打错的 id 什么都拿不到」 Existing api specs: who can send to whom and who can read it — colleague delivered; self, email address, empty text refused; an outsider and a mistyped id get nothing

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U5 The handoff is generated and delivered entirely in-app, only to a signed-in, valid Round Companion recipient (another physician's account), never to an arbitrary email address; …（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 6；TFA-92586 AC 7） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr
  • U6 Every sent handoff leaves a persistent record (sender, recipient, timestamp) that both the sender and the recipient can retrieve.（UAT TC-08；TFA-92586 AC 8） — gate: blocked: TFA-92586 ready for pr

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given Three accounts: sender, recipient and an outsider (CONTEXT_USER)

When Send to self, to 'someone@example.com', with whitespace text; list recipients; the outsider fetches the handoff by id, lists inbox and sent and tries markRead; the sender fetches a bogus id

Then Self → 'not to yourself'; email string → 'not a RoundCompanion user'; empty → 'nothing to hand off'; picker rows are {userId, name} only, never the caller; the outsider gets null / no rows / 'Handoff not found'; a bogus id returns null, no crash. Colleague row is S05; disabled-account row is S19

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Table from AC 7 ('only a signed-in, valid recipient, not an arbitrary email address') and AC 8 ('retrievable by both sender and recipient', no one else): every non-account destination refused and every outsider read empty, server-side; Playwright assertions. Not in the table: a header-only, zero-patient sheet is accepted by the server (only whitespace is refused), see risks

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S07 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-08.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数）；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
